Test # 1550
The Ashes, 2001, 1st Test
England v Australia
Edgbaston, Birmingham
5,6,7,8 July 2001 (5-day match)

Result: Australia won by an innings and 118 runs
Series: Australia leads the 5-Test series 1-0

Toss: Australia
Umpires: SA Bucknor (WI) and G Sharp
TV Umpire: KE Palmer
Match Referee: Talat Ali (Pak)
Test Debut: U Afzaal (Eng).
